lines.trans: Who does not know we need changes? The real question is in which direction.
If we scrap the entire media jury, how will our publicity operations tie in?
In media resources we cannot outmatch our rival; they just completed a media merger.
No matter how capable our boss is, at best we would only fight to a draw there.
Besides, was that not just your dear old Wen Simo making casual remarks on TV?
Look at how much hair oil he slicks on — more and more every episode.
You are the old man! How is Wen Simo old in the slightest?
He is well past forty already — listen to you!
A grown man like you gossiping all day and spouting nonsense.
Widening the lead over Supernova has been on our boss's mind all along.
True, it is his idea, yet he is in hospital right now — let us not trouble him with work.
Next season's competition rules must change, or we will not pull ahead of Supernova.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun lǎotóu ('old fellow', playful or blunt).

examples.text: 你才是老头呢，我们家闻老师哪儿老了？
examples.trans: You are the old guy — how is Wen Simo old at all?

examples.text: 那位精神抖擞的老头是退休的老台长。
examples.trans: That spirited older gentleman is the retired station head.

examples.text: 我去那儿当实习生，就能上十二歌王的组。
examples.trans: Translation.

examples.text: 这是能。
examples.trans: This is 能.

examples.text: 你们俩要做好思想准备。
examples.trans: The two of you need to be mentally prepared.

examples.text: 这是要。
examples.trans: This is 要.

examples.text: 这是要是啊。
examples.trans: This is if.

examples.text: 那个要是好。
examples.trans: That if is good.

examples.text: 要是去掉所有媒体评审，宣传怎么配合？
examples.trans: If we drop the entire media jury, how does publicity work?

examples.text: 五十位大众评审在现场投票选出冠军。
examples.trans: Fifty audience jurors voted live to pick the winner.

examples.text: 你敢说你不是为了他，放弃到手的金饭碗？

examples.trans: Whose is this?

examples.text: 这些资源都是我多年攒下的。
examples.trans: All of these contacts are ones I saved up over many years.

examples.text: 这是资源。
examples.trans: Translation.

meanings.note: Correlative adverb yuè in 越 A 越 B.

examples.text: 再这么闹下去，部门关系越闹越僵。
examples.trans: Pressing this further will only make ties stiffer and stiffer.

examples.text: 雨越下越大了。
examples.trans: The rain is falling harder and harder.

examples.text: 不改规则就跟对手的节目拉不开距离。
examples.trans: Without rule changes, we cannot open a lead over rivals.

examples.text: 保持适当镜头距离能让画面更自然。
examples.trans: Keeping proper camera distance makes shots look natural.

examples.text: 我跟他不一样，我要了一个实习生的名额。
examples.trans: I am different from him; I asked for one intern spot.

examples.text: 这是跟。
examples.trans: Translation.

examples.text: 如果去掉媒体评审，后台宣传运营怎么配合？
examples.trans: Without a media jury, how do publicity operations tie in?

examples.text: 新媒体团队专门负责节目官方账号的运营。
examples.trans: The digital team runs the show's official accounts.

examples.text: 我还约了人，你们先回去吧。
examples.trans: I also have an appointment with someone; you two head back first.

examples.text: 这是还。
examples.trans: This is 还.

examples.trans: Whose is this?

examples.text: 这是谁的呀？
examples.trans: Whose is this?

examples.text: 那太好了，谢谢啊！
examples.trans: That would be wonderful, thank you!

examples.text: 这是那。
examples.trans: Translation.

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.text: 这是都。
examples.trans: This is 都.

examples.text: 如果有不配合的员工，马上停职。
examples.trans: Anyone who refuses to cooperate is suspended at once.

examples.text: 你应该知道主持人怎么跟制作人配合。
examples.trans: You know how a host works in sync with a producer.

examples.text: 没问题，老师。
examples.trans: No problem, Professor.

examples.text: 这是问题。
examples.trans: This is 问题.

examples.text: 不就是主持人在电视上随口说了几句吗？
examples.trans: Was that not just the host making casual remarks on air?

examples.text: 没想到她随口提的点子成了全场的亮点。
examples.trans: An offhand idea she mentioned became the highlight.

meanings.note: Colloquial adverb dǐngduō ('at the very most').

examples.text: 就算再努力，在这方面顶多也只能打个平手。
examples.trans: Even going all out, at best we fight to a draw there.

examples.text: 从公司走到茶馆顶多只要十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the office to the teahouse takes ten minutes at most.
